title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on src/moeb/src/tools/fix_signal.rs
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found' twice on fix_signal.rs when attempting to add reasoning_reviewer_role load and substitution. The file uses Windows CRLF line endings; the patch old_string contained LF only. Both attempts failed. The operation was recovered by falling back to write_file with complete content, so the intended change was applied successfully.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file CRLF normalization (moeb.patch-file-crlf-normalize specification) did not strip CR characters from fix_signal.rs file content before exact-string matching. The normalization should cover all .rs files on Windows.
